children.value: > Fact From Story: Apple is in court because of something called the Information Services Agreement, or ISA: a deal that makes Google’s search engine the default on Apple’s products.

> > Fact From Story: the deal between Google and Apple — which makes Google the default search engine on all Apple devices and pays Apple billions of dollars a year — is central to the US Department of Justice’s case against Google.
> > > Fact From Story: Cue was on the stand as a witness in US v. Google, the landmark antitrust trial over Google’s search business.

> > > Fact From Story: The Justice Department is focused on the deals Google makes — with Apple but also with Samsung and Mozilla and many others — to ensure it is the default search engine on practically every platform.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Court cases usually involve witnesses giving testimony.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Deals that are central to a case are often discussed in court.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Companies go to court to resolve disputes.
